Instead it reads as a banded/striped semi-opaque cylindrical form with volume-like slicing artifacts, suggesting the sim/render is not producing a liquid surface mesh (or the domain is behaving like smoke/VDB volume rather than liquid).

actual_behavior: No recognizable liquid jet/puddle; image shows smooth/banded translucent stripes and a solid-looking cylinder with ghosting/banding, more consistent with a misconfigured domain/material (smoke/volume) or missing liquid mesh/particle render.

recommended_fix: Force LIQUID domain and ensure a LIQUID surface mesh is generated and rendered: (1) explicitly set domain_settings.domain_type='LIQUID' and domain_settings.use_mesh=True; (2) call the dedicated mesh bake operator after data bake (bake_data then bake_mesh, or bake_all + bake_mesh depending on Blender build); (3) ensure the generated liquid mesh object is not hidden and has the water material; (4) prevent/avoid automation applying a Principled Volume material to the domain (smoke), or ignore domain volume and render only the surface mesh.
